svg.title: File System Engine: Explorer
svg.desc: The File System Engine window in its dark theme on the Explorer tab, browsing an Android phone named Pixel 8 over adb at sdcard, DCIM, Camera, with 18 site photos and videos listed by name, kind and size. The Select Drive menu is open and lists System, Home, Downloads, Documents, Desktop, the Studio Archive drive and the Pixel 8. Fictional demo data.

g.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
